text:
amy: Heads-up — depot queue for H100 inbound from VendorX is ballooning. ETA slipped again to 04/09 due to customs hold. We have 48 pending replacements that are blocking provisioning for Dedicated pools. :exclamation:
raj: Ugh. Which SKUs/serials? Can we swap to H200 or temporary quantized variants in the meantime? :thinking:
lee: List is here (internal): inventory-cli list --sku H100 --status in-transit
lee: output snippet:
```
HW   | SKU  | SERIAL       | STATUS      | LOC
-----+------+--------------+-------------+-----------
H100 | H100 | HX12345ABC   | customs-hold| EU-AMS
H100 | H100 | HX12346ABC   | in-transit  | NL-FR
```
amy: Most are EU-AMS receiving. Vendor says customs paperwork incomplete on 14 units, plus 6 flagged for DOA returns (RMA). Vendor is offering loaners but charging an expedite fee of $4k/unit + air freight.
dan_vendor: Confirming — VendorX here. Customs delay due to HS-code mismatch on 14 units. We can reclassify and push release, but timeline depends on broker. Loaner fleet available (A100s mixed) but limited to 10 units for next 7 days. Expedited shipping estimate attached.
maria_logistics: Broker confirmed reclassification should clear in 48–72h if we sign the corrected docs. I uploaded draft to the shared drive: https://drive.example/reclassify-H100-2266
amy: Thanks. Cost is a problem — finance flagged surge charge. If we take loaners, performance/per-cost impact on ML jobs will increase. Any other routing? Can we send some to DE-FRA regional DC where we can onboard faster?
raj: We have warm Dedicated slots in EU-FR with spare capacity. Ops-SRE can do temporary region routing but need serials on file and certs. What's the ETA if we route to DE-FRA?
maria_logistics: Air manifest to FRA could be same-day once broker clears, then 24h for depot intake. So earliest Fri if broker clears by tomorrow.
ops-bot: Alert — cluster-autoscaler observes GPU-queue length +42% since 06:00 UTC. Predicted SLA breach for low-latency routes in 18h if no capacity added. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/queues/alert/22666
lee: If we accept loaners, we need to stub serials into provisioning and mark as temporary to avoid billing mismatches. Command to add: infra-admin add-serial --pool dedicated-eu-fr --sku A100 --serial <SERIAL> --temp true
raj: Proposal: sign reclassification (fastest, cheapest), request vendor to split the manifest: release 34 units to FRA hub, hold remainder for full customs cycle. Accept 8 loaners to cover highest-priority jobs only. Negotiate reduce expedite fee to $1.2k/unit for loaners as a goodwill credit.
dan_vendor: I can push split manifest and request fee reduction, but final approval from VendorX ops needed. I will escalate with the broker and finance.
amy: Also need RMA plan for the 6 DOA units — vendor, confirm turnaround time for replacements vs depot repair? We need ETA on replacements for capacity planning.
dan_vendor: Standard RMA replace ETA 14–21 days from receipt; depot repair 7–10 days but risk of extended test cycles. We can prioritize replacements for critical serials if you provide the list now.
maria_logistics: I'll compile the DOA list and AWBs. AWB for the stuck pallet: 1Z999AA10123456784. Customs contact: broker@eu-broker.example.
lee: Quick check on provisioning side: can we hot-swap jobs to quantized hf models temporarily to reduce GPU demand? Many pipelines can drop to int8 with minimal perf loss. Ops, can you schedule a canary?
raj: Yes — we can throttle low-priority training and shift inference to smaller shards. Ops team to run policy change: autoscale-config set --priority-throttle training --limit 60%
ops-bot: Action logged by ops: ticket INFRA-1129 created to track loaner onboarding + manifest split + RMA list. ETA field updated.
amy: Great. Dan, please push for the fee reduction and manifest split ASAP. Maria, please upload signed reclassification doc when ready. I'll update product teams on capacity impact. :ship: 
dan_vendor: Will do. Escalating now. I'll post back with vendor confirmation or counteroffer within 4h.
maria_logistics: Reclassification signed and uploaded (v1) — drive link updated.
lee: Noted. I'll prepare the temporary serial ingestion playbook and share in #eng-infra once loaners confirmed.
amy: Thanks team. Let's aim to have loaners staged OR manifest split confirmed before EOD. :clock10:
